subject: Fix SSHDotNetDiagnosticsTests compilation
body:
Fix SSHDotNetDiagnosticsTests compilation

The SSH_DotNet diagnostics tests never compiled (they were committed
without building the test project). Two fixes:

- MessageCollector exposes Messages (IEnumerable<IMessage>), not Count;
  use Messages.Count() and add a System.Linq using.
- The Options*Page settings classes are internal sealed; add
  [assembly: InternalsVisibleTo("mRemoteNGTests")] so the tests can drive
  the UI-setting-dependent code paths in LogTrace/LogEscapeSequence.

All 11 tests pass. (On Windows 10, build the test project with
-p:SupportedOSPlatformVersion=10.0.19041.0 to run them locally.)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: Test fix for joubertdj's fork-only SSHDotNet protocol; no SshDotNet code exists in our fork, so tests and InternalsVisibleTo target nothing here.
